result.question: What plan did more than forty men present to the chief priests and elders?

readings.answer: Have the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring Paul for a hearing so they could ambush and kill him on the way.
readings.support: petition the commander to bring him down to you on the pretext of examining his case more carefully | We are ready to kill him on the way.

assessments.reason: The reading restates v.15: “you and the Sanhedrin petition the commander to bring him down… on the pretext of examining his case more carefully. We are ready to kill him on the way,” with “for a hearing” as a natural paraphrase and “ambush” implied by killing him en route.

result.reason: Verse 23:15 explicitly states the plan to request Paul be brought for a supposed examination so they could kill him on the way.
